pages.title: Small Storage
pages.text: Craft a basket from sticks and compatible strings. Right-click to open its nine-slot menu. Unlike processing stations, it is a normal small inventory container.

pages.title: Transfer and Signals
pages.text: Hoppers and item automation transfer contents; a comparator reports fullness. Breaking the basket drops its stored items rather than making a portable sealed inventory. Place one beside manual stations for materials and finished goods.
